title: 99 Nights More like 99 Wins
features:
Automated Tree Farming (Tree Aura): "Tired of endlessly chopping wood? This feature automatically finds and harvests trees within your chosen vicinity. It's smart enough to pick the best axe or chainsaw from your inventory, ensuring efficient resource gathering. You can even fine-tune how quickly it works and how far it reaches."

Automatic Healing: "Keep your health consistently high without a second thought. This function automatically uses Medkits or Bandages found nearby whenever your health drops below a percentage you define. It's a true lifesaver for staying in the action."

Combat Automation (Kill Aura): "Engage in combat with a significant edge. Our Kill Aura feature automatically targets and attacks nearby enemies, allowing you to focus on strategy. Adjust its range and attack speed to best suit your playstyle."

Enhanced Movement Capabilities:

Customizable Walkspeed: "Set your character's walking speed to your exact preference, from a leisurely stroll to a rapid dash."

Infinite Jump: "Gain the ability to jump repeatedly, giving you unmatched vertical mobility for exploration or evasion."

Noclip: "Move freely through any object or terrain in the game, opening up new pathways and secrets."

Full Fly System: "Take to the skies with complete control. This feature lets you fly smoothly at adjustable speeds, making traversal across the map effortless."

Instant Teleportation Options:

Quick Warps to Key Locations: "Instantly travel to essential spots like the Campfire or Crafting Bench."

Item Retrieval: "Summon any selected items directly to your location, whether you need just a few or every single one available."

Locate Lost Children: "Quickly find and teleport to lost children, simplifying rescue missions."

Chest Finder: "Warp directly to chests across the map for immediate looting."

Mothership Access: "During the Alien Event, you can instantly transport yourself to the Mothership."

Visual Enhancements (ESP - Extra Sensory Perception):

Player & Entity Outlines: "See other players, important items, chests, and enemies highlighted through walls, giving you a crucial tactical advantage."

Customizable Colors: "Personalize the colors of your ESP highlights to your liking."

World & Environment Control:

Full Brightness: "Say goodbye to dark and murky areas. This option illuminates the entire environment."

No Fog: "Clear the air completely, providing an unobstructed view of the game world."

Instant Interactions: "Bypass the 'hold to interact' mechanic on proximity prompts, making interactions immediate."

Time of Day Control: "Set the game's clock to any hour you prefer, and even lock it there, ensuring perfect lighting conditions at all times."

Automated Safety (Safe Zone): "For those moments when survival is critical, this feature automatically creates a temporary safe zone in the sky, moving you there when your health is dangerously low. Once you're stable, it can return you to your previous location or the campfire."

Automated Hunger Management: "Never worry about hunger again. This system automatically consumes specified food items to keep your hunger levels in check."

Features:
